mapper.sql: select b.booking_id, b.lead_id, b.visitor_id, b.app_user_id, b.product_code, b.product_name, b.slot_id, b.consultant_id, u.nick_name as consultant_name, l.display_name as lead_name, b.start_time, b.end_time, b.mode, b.status, b.source, b.note, b.cancel_reason, b.reschedule_count, b.create_by, b.create_time from abr_booking b left join sys_user u on u.user_id = b.consultant_id left join abr_lead l on l.lead_id = b.lead_id
mapper.select: select count(*) from abr_booking where app_user_id = #{appUserId} and status = 'booked' and start_time > now()
mapper.insert: insert into abr_booking (lead_id, visitor_id, app_user_id, product_code, product_name, slot_id, consultant_id, start_time, end_time, mode, status, source, note, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{leadId}, #{visitorId}, #{appUserId}, #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{slotId}, #{consultantId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{mode}, 'booked', #{source}, coalesce(#{note}, ''), #{createBy}, now(), #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update abr_booking set slot_id = #{slotId}, consultant_id = #{consultantId}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, mode = #{mode}, reschedule_count = reschedule_count + 1, reminded_time = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where booking_id = #{bookingId} and status = 'booked'
update abr_booking set status = #{status}, cancel_reason = coalesce(#{reason}, ''), update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where booking_id = #{bookingId} and status = 'booked'
mapper.select: where b.status = 'booked' and b.reminded_time is null and b.start_time > #{now} and b.start_time <= #{until} and b.create_time <= b.start_time - make_interval(hours => #{hours}) order by b.start_time limit 200
mapper.update: update abr_booking set reminded_time = now() where booking_id = #{bookingId} and reminded_time is null
mapper.select: with recursive start as ( select lead_id from abr_lead where del_flag = '0' and (lead_id = #{leadId} or app_user_id = #{appUserId} or visitor_id = #{visitorId}) ), chain(lead_id, merged_into, depth) as ( select l.lead_id, l.merged_into, 0 from abr_lead l join start s on s.lead_id = l.lead_id union all select l.lead_id, l.merged_into, c.depth + 1 from abr_lead l join chain c on l.lead_id = c.merged_into where c.depth < 10 ) select l.lead_id as "leadId", l.stage as "stage", l.owner_user_id as "ownerUserId", l.minor as "minor", l.display_name as "displayName", l.app_user_id as "appUserId", (select count(*) from abr_booking b where b.lead_id = l.lead_id and b.status = 'booked' and b.start_time > now()) as "activeBookings" from chain c join abr_lead l on l.lead_id = c.lead_id where c.merged_into is null and l.del_flag = '0' order by l.lead_id limit 1
